'''''Cyperus prolifer''''' is a species of [[Cyperus|sedge]] that is native to eastern [[Africa]], ranging from [[Somalia]] to the [[Cape Provinces]] of [[South Africa]], and to [[Madagascar]] and [[Mauritius]].<ref name=kew>{{cite web|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:305624-1|title=''Cyperus prolifer'' Lam.|access-date=19 May 2022|publisher=Kew Science – Plants of the World Online}}</ref> It is introduced and considered invasive in [[Florida]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Cyperus prolifer |url=https://plants.ifas.ufl.edu/plant-directory/cyperus-prolifer/ |website=University of Florida / IFAS Center for Aquatic and Invasive Plants |access-date=24 August 2022}}</ref>
